caveat: New immutable Week7 cohort v8 (Saturday provider refresh, asset Oct 24 11:57:46Z: official game designations and Friday practice for all 28 playing teams; Nacua Q/calf/DNP-Friday now provider-carried, v7 news override dropped; v1-v7 stay as published); unvalidated experiment, not a betting edge. Baseline frozen and shown beside it.
method: Same Oct7 fitted practice/status residual-margin coefficients as Week 5/6 cohorts, no refit (fit sha256 87e03553c5bd90a1123710d222e25af72042262f3251c6c24bfb30563545e358). Snap weights through Week6; 2025 fallback for missing. Refreshed IR inventory (Oct 23 12:36:57Z roster asset) + Week 7 report rows with official game designations (all 28 playing teams, Oct 24 11:57:46Z injuries asset) + verified news; adjustment relative to no-injury row. No book/weather inputs or manual point bumps.
limitations: All 28 playing teams have Week 7 practice rows in the provider injury file as of its Oct 23 12:34:19Z asset update. TNF teams CHI/NE are final (played Thursday); PIT has game designations for the early Sunday kickoff (Echols and Skowronek Out); other Sunday/Monday teams are practice participation only until their reports land later today and Saturday. This cohort will be superseded.
Game designations are as of the Saturday provider asset; late scratches or Sunday-morning workout decisions (e.g. Nacua pregame workout) are not captured.
IR provider inventory is not a 32-team transaction audit and long absences can already be in the scores-only baseline, so double counting is possible.
Missing snap roles have zero contribution and are listed, not assumed healthy.
No fitted DNP play probability or teammate redistribution.
Nacua Questionable contributes only the question/DNP features (uncertainty preserved, no IR/Out zeroing); his pregame workout Sunday decides availability per coach McVay (ESPN Oct 23).
Totals and home-win probabilities stay baseline; the injury-total candidate worsened diagnostics.
Unproven: two straight one-week diagnostics (Weeks 5 and 6) favored the baseline. Shown beside the baseline per the standing Oct 7 instruction; NOT promoted.

news_overrides: Puka Nacua (LA WR) Questionable, calf, DNP Friday - now provider-carried in the Oct 24 asset (v7's dated ESPN override dropped; pregame workout to decide per McVay)
Terry McLaurin (WSH WR) Out for season (coach Dan Quinn via ESPN Oct 20; torn patellar tendon per ESPN/NBC Sports PFT; WSH on bye, still not roster-reflected)
Davante Adams (LA WR) IR, roster-confirmed Oct 21 (hamstring, out 6-10 weeks per McVay Oct 19)
Poona Ford (LA DT) IR, roster-confirmed Oct 21 (out for season per AP Oct 19)
